answer: Each identity registers on one island with a 70-credit bond. Every gale season it pays a tax: first identity 40, k-th 40+12(k-1). A zephyr lull opens a short payment window; a miss doubles the tax, a second miss burns the bond. Auditors recompute each tax from the public island ledger and gale manifest. 1,000 fakes cost 6,034,000 plus 70,000 locked. An honest agent pays 40 once. A rented-tax ring cannot hide shared keys.
